"''They're ''not'' using speeders!|Enric Pryde and Masir Trach, upon seeing the Resistance's orbak mounts|audio=Pryde-Trach-Speeders-TROS.flac|}} '''Masir Trach''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[commander]] and scanner [[officer]] in the [[First Order]], and held a rank befitting that of a senior officer.His uniform is depicted as teal-colored, which ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary|Star Wars: The Force Awakens Visual Dictionary]]'' stated was reserved for senior officer ranks such as [[Major]] and [[Colonel]] within the First Order. Previously assigned to the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'', when Trach was transferred to the [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']] he was caught in the rivalry between [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] and [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]], the commanders of the ''Finalizer'' and ''Steadfast'' respectively after the ''Finalizer'' was crippled during the [[Battle of Batuu]] and [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] had Hux transferred with him to the ''Steadfast'' when the [[Ren|leader]] of the [[Knights of Ren]] took the ship as his new Destroyer to prevent his old rival from starting a mutiny. Although Trach could sense the tension between the two officers and was aware that the orders they gave him carried ulterior political moments, to avoid dispute he chose to focus on carrying out the letter of his orders. Trach participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]], the final confrontation in the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]] as part of the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]]. During the battle, Trach witnessed a group of Resistance fighters, led by former First Order [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]], launch a ground assault on [[Exegol]] riding [[orbak]] mounts. He declared his shock that they used animals rather than [[speeder]]s, preventing their opponents from using technology to disable the vehicles. The ''Steadfast'' was ultimately destroyed and the Resistance won the battle. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Masir Trach first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|Skywalker saga]], where he was portrayed by Egyptian-British actor [[Amir El-Masry]]. The character's surname was revealed in the film's credits, where he is listed as "[[Commander]] Trach," while his forename was revealed in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Masir Trach}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Merry Rise of Skywalker: Star Wars Part the Ninth]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Masir}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Masir Trach |fr=Masir Trach |ja=マシア・トラク |ka=მასირ ტრეჩი |pl=Masir Trach}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Trach, Masir}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the First Order]] [[Category:Officers of the Sith Eternal]]
